title: structure-index.v1
description: structure-recovery ACCUMULATED catalog — the queryable cross-file structure index produced by accumulate_structure.py (per-file summary) and the cross-file pass (store.py build_catalog). Unlike structure-finding.v1 (per-chunk, DECLARED facts, offsets MUST be null), this catalog carries the DETERMINISTICALLY COMPUTED byte layout from scripts/cobol_offset_calc.py: per-field byte_offset / length, and for variable-length records byte_offset_min / byte_offset_max / variable_length / ranged, plus gap-flagged fields (SYNCHRONIZED, ODO-tail, unresolved-COPY). Relationships are resolved across files (SQL declared FK = grounded; convention *_id = inferred; COBOL cross-record = speculative, opt-in --infer-relationships). Every entity/field/relationship carries confidence x evidence_kind x enforcement. Inferred DDL and speculative FKs derived from this index are advisory-only, human-review-headered, and NEVER executed (design §5 / §6).

extractor_version.description: SemVer of the extractor that produced this catalog.

generated_with.description: Provenance of the catalog build: the job fingerprint and option flags that produced it (run_state.py). Lets a renderer/consumer detect a stale or differently-configured catalog.

job_fingerprint.description: The outer sha256 job fingerprint from run_state.py (folds project_root + file-set snapshot + options + prompt/extractor/schema/normalizer versions + model_id). NOT the legacy-code-intel pipeline_fingerprint (which it wraps, never widens).

infer_relationships.description: Whether the --infer-relationships flag was set (decision O2). When false, NO COBOL cross-record FKs appear in relationships[].

partial.description: OPTIONAL. True when the run finalized status:partial (wall-clock cap). Consumers banner this. Default false.

entities.description: The accumulated objects (tables, views, COBOL records, flat-file layouts), identity-canonicalized across files (CREATE + later ALTER unioned, latest ALTER wins).

qualified_name.description: Canonical qualified name of the entity.

record_length.description: Computed record length (01-level length for COBOL; sum of fixed field lengths for flat-file) when fixed. null when variable (see variable_length) or not computable. Computed by cobol_offset_calc.py, NEVER declared.

record_length_min.description: Lower bound of record length for a variable-length (ODO) record. null when fixed/unknown.

record_length_max.description: Upper bound of record length for a variable-length (ODO) record. null when fixed/unknown.

variable_length.description: True when this entity has at least one OCCURS DEPENDING ON tail making the record length variable. The renderer/DDL must not assert a single record length.

fields.description: The merged, offset-computed field tree for this entity.

level.description: COBOL level number; null for SQL/flat-file.

parent.description: Name (or ordinal-path) of the COBOL group parent, for hierarchy reconstruction. null for top-level/non-COBOL.

byte_offset.description: COMPUTED 0-indexed byte offset within the record (cobol_offset_calc.py). null when ranged/unknown — then byte_offset_min/byte_offset_max apply, or the field is gap-flagged (SYNC/ODO-tail/unresolved-COPY).

length.description: COMPUTED byte length (cobol_offset_calc.py). Group length = sum(children). 88/66 and implied-decimal V/P = 0. null when not computable.

byte_offset_min.description: Lower-bound offset for a field positioned after an ODO tail or under SYNC. null when a single byte_offset is authoritative.

byte_offset_max.description: Upper-bound offset for a field positioned after an ODO tail or under SYNC. null when a single byte_offset is authoritative.

ranged.description: True when the offset/length is a RANGE rather than a single authoritative value (post-ODO position, or SYNCHRONIZED alignment slack). The renderer must show min..max, NEVER a single confident value (Codex Finding 1).

variable_length.description: True when this specific field's length is variable (it IS the ODO array, or follows one). Default false.

pic_clause.description: COBOL PICTURE verbatim; null for SQL/flat-file.

declared_type.description: Declared SQL/DSX type verbatim; null otherwise.

occurs.description: Fixed OCCURS count; null when not an array.

occurs_max.description: ODO upper bound; null when not ODO.

occurs_depending_on.description: ODO controlling field; null when not ODO.

redefines.description: Name of the REDEFINES target (shares offset); null otherwise.

is_group.description: True for COBOL group items; null for non-COBOL.

offset_confidence.description: Confidence of the COMPUTED offset specifically (design §3.3). grounded = clean DISPLAY/COMP/COMP-3 chain. inferred = group-propagated USAGE. speculative = SYNC / ODO-tail / unresolved-COPY (also ranged or gap-flagged). Distinct from the field's declaration confidence below.

confidence.description: Confidence in the field DECLARATION (design §5), lower-confidence-wins across merged duplicates.

evidence_kind.description: How the field was learned (same closed enum as the finding).

enforcement.description: Whether enforcement is declared (NOT NULL etc.) or unknown.

evidence.description: OPTIONAL file:line provenance for the field declaration (for wiki/DDL citation).

confidence.description: Entity-level declaration confidence (most conservative across fields).

evidence.description: file:line provenance of the entity's primary declaration site.

gaps.description: Per-entity gaps carried up from the contributing chunks plus any introduced during offset computation (e.g. sync_alignment, odo_variable_length).

relationships.description: Cross-file resolved relationships. SQL declared FK = grounded; convention *_id->id = inferred join hint; SQL JOIN ON = kind=join (inferred); COBOL cross-record FK = speculative and present ONLY when generated_with.infer_relationships is true (capped at speculative, name+type+length match required, advisory/commented-DDL only).

kind.description: pk / fk / join (inferred, advisory) / unique. Same closed enum as the finding.

from_object.description: Qualified name of the owning entity.

to_object.description: Referenced entity (fk/join); null for pk/unique or unresolved.

evidence_kind.description: How the relationship was learned (same closed enum).

enforcement.description: declared for SQL FK/PK/UNIQUE and DSX key flags; unknown for inferred/observed.

confidence.description: grounded (declared FK/PK/UNIQUE, DSX keys), inferred (*_id, JOIN ON), speculative (COBOL cross-record, dynamic). FK/relationship edges are advisory until a gold/ schema oracle clears an accuracy gate — they NEVER feed a gate (design §5).

gaps.description: Catalog-level gaps (files skipped, oversized, redacted, language-unsupported) not attributable to a single entity.

kind.description: Closed enum. Superset of the finding's gap kinds plus accumulate/cross-file gaps: position_mismatch = a flat-file declared offset disagreed with the computed sequence (field downgraded); boundary_issue = an orphan/tie merge across a chunk overlap.

file_path.description: Repo-relative path of the gap site (forward-slash). null for catalog-wide gaps.

line.description: 1-indexed line of the gap site (file-relative). null when not line-specific.
